title: Würth Group | World Economic Forum
content: # Würth Group. The Würth Group is a worldwide wholesaler of fasteners, screws and screw accessories, dowels, chemicals, electronic and electromechanical components, furniture and construction fittings, tools, machines, installation material, automotive hardware, inventory management, storage and retrieval systems. Headquartered in Kunzelsau, Germany, with over 400 companies in 84 countries. It is primarily active in industrial distribution, focusing on assembly technology and fasteners, and chemical engineering products and connectors. In addition to German parent company Adolf Würth, Würth includes more than 400 companies in 86 countries. Visit the Würth Group website.

title: Global Fastener Industry Meets in Germany | fastenerexpo.de
content: Home / Event Updates / Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt: Global Fastener Industry Meets in Germany. # Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt: Global Fastener Industry Meets in Germany. The global fastener industry is preparing for one of the **most important trade fairs in Europe**: **Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt**, happening from **March 23–25, 2026** at the **Messe Frankfurt Exhibition Center**. If you’re involved in **fastener manufacturing, distribution, or supply chain management**, this is the must-attend event of the year. ## First Exhibitors Confirmed for Fastener Expo Frankfurt 2026. Fastener Expo Frankfurt (FEF) has revealed the **first batch of exhibitors**, highlighting the international diversity of the fastener industry. **Optimas Solutions** is a global leader in **industrial fasteners and C-parts supply**. One of the highlights of **Fastener Expo Germany** is its international cooperation with global fastener associations. **Fastener Expo 2026 Frankfurt** is more than just a **fastener exhibition** — it’s where the **global fastening industry** meets to do business, share knowledge, and shape the future of fastening technology.

title: Fastener Expo Frankfurt launches in 2026
content: Fastener Expo Frankfurt launches in 2026 27 January 2026. A new event is set to energise Europe’s manufacturing and engineering industries, with Fastener Expo Frankfurt – scheduled for 23rd – 25th March 2026 – taking place at Messe Frankfurt in Germany. EBSEEK Exhibition states that Fastener Expo Frankfurt will bring together 300+ international exhibitors and thousands of professional buyers across automotive, aerospace, machinery, construction, renewable energy, as well as next generation manufacturing applications. “Fastener Expo Frankfurt is designed to become Europe’s new meeting place for fastener technology – where global manufacturing strength meets Europe’s engineering demand, all in one strategic location,” reports Klaus Liermann, managing director for EBSEEK Exhibition. At Fastener Expo Frankfurt there will also be a VIP Buyer Programme, which is designed for professional buyers with active sourcing needs. In partnership with European automotive OEMs, Fastener Expo Frankfurt will also feature live demonstrations featuring passenger and commercial vehicles that are equipped with fastening and fixing applications, as well as an assembly torque wrench showcase.
